input: The work each finished pass did (seconds of media read) while every reader was busy, and when the readers gave way or had nothing to read.
output: How many readers may run now, and each decision (one more is tried, or the run settles). It reads nothing, writes nothing and runs no worker.
specification: User 2026-10-18: the number of readers is found by a short test so it adapts to the speed of the reader. The first passes are the test (no extra reading): a level is judged by the work finished per second; one more reader stays while it brings at least a tenth more, then the best level stays for the run.
